Ceres Chill — Amazon A+ Content Wireframe

This wireframe maps out the seven A+ Content modules for every Ceres Chill product on Amazon. The modules build from the brand story to features, how to use and comparison, extending the gallery images without repeating them.

How to walk through it: pick a product, then scroll top to bottom the way a shopper would. Each card shows an example image (a third party layout reference only), a short visual description of our version, and the copy for that module. Red lines are required safety notes; yellow lines are details we still need from you.

Ceres Chill OG Plus, 28 oz

The flagship breastmilk cooler and warmer. It chills up to 28 oz of fresh milk for 24 hours, warms a bottle with hot water and comes in 17 colorways. The images walk a working mom from "can I really pump anywhere" to "yes, and it matches my bag."
